paragraphs.text: DSH bundle: translate installed plugins' documentation into Simplified Chinese with a persistent seg
translate installed plugins' documentation into Simplified Chinese with a persistent segment cache.
# Chinese Plugin Docs
English | 中文（由本插件自动翻译）
Translate the documentation of any installed plugin on the Plugins page into Simplified Chinese — bo
th the long detail document and the list-row title/description one-liners — keep every result in a p
ersistent cache, and re-translate only the parts a plugin update actually changes.
## Summary
DSH plugins ship their user documentation as an English README (or a `meta.detail` document), and th
eir list rows show the bundle's `meta.title` / `meta.description` with a literal English fallback. T
his bundle does two things:
1. Adds a **中文说明** control to the head of every installed plugin's detail page. The control opens a

dialog with the translated long document, live progress, and cache statistics.
2. Makes the **Plugin
s list itself render Chinese**: it translates each bundle's short one-line meta and writes the resul
t into the bundle's own locale files, so the host's normal locale resolution displays it natively —
no client-side DOM patching.
All translations are produced by the model selected as the agent default (or an explicitly configure
d provider and model), and are stored under `$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/dsh-plugin-readme-zh/` (Markdown
segments plus short strings).
## Use this plugin
1. Install the bundle. On every start it automatically translates the list one-liners of all install

ed plugins (in the background; already-cached strings cost nothing).
2. Open **Settings → Plugins**:

installed rows now show Chinese one-line descriptions next to their package names.
3. Open any inst

alled plugin's detail page; its header shows a **中文说明** button. Select it.
4. On first use the docum
ent is translated and the dialog shows a progress bar. Later visits read the cache and open instantl

y.
5. **重新翻译** forces a fresh translation. **翻译全部已安装插件** translates every installed plugin's long do
cument in the background (and refreshes the list one-liners too); progress appears beside the button

.
6. **复制中文** copies the translated Markdown.
The detail button is hidden when the plugin has no readable document, its files are unavailable, or
its document is already Chinese.
## How the list rows become Chinese
Opt-in via `metaSidecars: true` (off by default). When enabled, for each profile-installed bundle th
e translations are kept in its own package directory:
- `locale/zh.json` gains `meta.title` / `meta.description` (merged into any existing file; author-pr

ovided Chinese is never touched);
- when the package ships no `locale/` directory at all, a `locale/
en.json` mirroring the original English text is added too, because the loader reads no locale dictio

naries without the English seed file;
- when the package declares an `exports` map, the standard DSH
entry `"./locale/*.json": "./locale/*.json"` is appended so the module resolver can see the locale
files (packages without an `exports` map need nothing).
These are small, additive, idempotent writes into the installed package's own directory; a `pnpm ins
tall` that re-extracts the package simply resets it, and the next start re-applies it from the strin
at re-extracts the package simply resets it, and the next start re-applies it from the string cache.
## Understand the cache
Every document is split into ordered Markdown segments:
- fenced code blocks, HTML comment blocks, and standalone HTML tag lines are kept verbatim and never

sent to the model;
- the text is cut at every Markdown heading (`#` … `######`) first, so each sect
ion becomes its own chunk group: inserting or reordering a section changes only that section's hashe

s, not the rest of the document;
- within a section, prose is packed into chunks of at most 3000 cha

racters at line boundaries;
- each chunk is keyed by the SHA-256 of its exact source text.
The cache file records the document hash, the chunk hashes, and their translations. When a plugin is
file records the document hash, the chunk hashes, and their translations. When a plugin is updated:

- unchanged chunks keep their hash and are reused;
- only chunks whose source text changed are sent

to the model;
- a version bump with an identical document costs no model calls at all.
A translation interrupted by a restart keeps its finished chunks, so the next run continues instead
errupted by a restart keeps its finished chunks, so the next run continues instead of starting over.
## Configuration
Set these fields on the bundle row in the profile patch when the defaults do not fit:
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `engine` | `auto` | `auto` prefers the model service and falls back to the translator service; `ll

m` requires a model; `translator` uses only `ctx.translator`. |
| `provider` | agent default | Model

provider route for translation. |
| `model` | agent default | Model id for translation. |
[该节后续省略]
## Limitations
- The long detail document and the list-row one-line meta are translated; deep configuration field l

abels, row titles, and in-document strings stay in their original language.
- The first translation
of a long document needs one model call per chunk; a 30 KB README usually takes a handful of calls.
- Transient model failures are retried on the model itself (three attempts with backoff). Only a str
uctural failure (no provider, missing credentials, exceeded context window) uses the anonymous trans

lator fallback, and that decision is made per chunk.
- A chunk that is almost entirely code or symbo
ls and still comes back without Chinese text is kept verbatim and counted under `keptSource`; it sta

ys that way on later runs of an unchanged document.
- A translated document is stored as a whole; ed

iting the cached file by hand is not supported.
- The dialog renders Markdown with a deliberately sm
all renderer. Raw HTML is reduced to its text content, external images are shown as their alt text,

and links are limited to HTTP(S), `mailto:`, and in-page anchors.
- The list-row translation (writin
g `locale/*.json` sidecars and one `exports` entry) is **opt-in via `metaSidecars: true`, off by def
ault**, so a public install does not touch other packages. When enabled, a `pnpm install` that re-ex

tracts a package resets those files; the next start re-applies them from the cache.
- The translatio
n cache belongs to this profile's `$DSH_HOME`; another profile starts with an empty cache.
